page.title: 文を説明する-ingの上級技

analysis.summaryJa: 文を説明する-ing句は文末・文頭・名詞のそばに置いて焦点を変えられる。通常は主節主語が動作主だが、異なる場合は-ing側にも独立した主語を置く。主節より前に完了した行為はHaving＋過去分詞で時間差を明示する。
grammarPoints: 文末・文頭・名詞のそばに置く-ing句の焦点差
独立分詞構文で-ing側の別主語を明示する形
Having＋過去分詞による先行完了
Having been＋過去分詞による受動の先行完了
visualEvidence: 画像の主文列車に-ing場面車両が接続し、3つの配置が示される
guideとchildrenの別トラックでthe children waitingの独立主語が明示される
Having packed→we leftの2段タイムラインが前後関係を表す
commonTraps: 別の動作主なのに-ing側の主語を省略する
主節と同時の動作にHaving＋過去分詞を使う
先に完了した行為を単純-ingだけで曖昧にする
名詞のそばの挿入句がどの名詞を説明するかを誤る

questions.prompt: ------- the final figures, the analyst sent the report.

choices.A: Checking after
choices.B: Having check
choices.D: Checked having

questions.translationJa: 最終数値を確認し終えてから、分析担当者は報告書を送りました。
questions.explanationJa: 確認が送信より先に完了したためHaving checkedを使います。

questions.prompt: The alarm sounded, ------- toward the emergency exit.

choices.A: employees moving
choices.B: moving
choices.D: to move employees

questions.translationJa: 警報が鳴り、従業員は非常口へ移動しました。
questions.explanationJa: 鳴る主語alarmと移動する主語employeesが異なるため、-ing側にemployeesを明示します。
questions.focus: 別主語の独立分詞構文

questions.prompt: Ms. Carter, ------- a stack of invoices, entered the meeting room.

choices.A: carried
choices.B: to carry
choices.D: carrying

questions.translationJa: 請求書の束を運びながら、カーターさんは会議室に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞Ms. Carterのそばのcarrying句がその人の同時動作を直接説明します。

questions.prompt: ------- the contract, both parties began the implementation phase.

choices.A: Signing after
choices.B: Having signed
choices.D: Signed having

questions.translationJa: 契約に署名し終えてから、双方は実施段階を開始しました。
questions.explanationJa: 署名完了が開始より前なのでHaving signedで順序を示します。

questions.prompt: The presentation ended, ------- questions in the chat unanswered.

choices.A: several
choices.B: answering several
choices.D: to several

questions.translationJa: 発表が終わりましたが、チャット内の複数の質問は未回答のままでした。
questions.explanationJa: several questions unansweredは独立した主語＋補語で、主節と別の状態を加えます。
questions.focus: 独立主語＋補語の付帯状況

questions.prompt: ------- by the director, the budget was distributed to managers.

choices.A: Having approved
choices.B: Being approve
choices.D: Approved having been

questions.translationJa: 部長に承認された後、予算は管理職へ配布されました。
questions.explanationJa: 予算は承認される側で、その完了が配布より前なのでHaving been approvedです。

questions.prompt: The delivery truck left the yard, ------- in the light rain.

choices.A: flashing its warning lights were
choices.B: its warning lights flashing
choices.D: to flash its warning lights

questions.translationJa: 配送トラックは、警告灯を点滅させながら構内を出ました。
questions.explanationJa: flashingの主語its warning lightsを明示した独立分詞構文です。
questions.focus: 所有限定詞付き独立主語

questions.prompt: ------- any confirmation, we postponed the installation.

choices.A: Having not receive
choices.B: Not received having
choices.D: Not having received

questions.translationJa: 確認を受け取っていなかったため、設置を延期しました。
questions.explanationJa: 受領なしが延期判断より前なのでNot having receivedを用います。

questions.prompt: The consultants, ------- quietly near the window, reviewed the revised plan.

choices.A: sat
choices.B: to sit
choices.D: having sit

questions.translationJa: 窓際に静かに座りながら、コンサルタントたちは修正案を確認しました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞直後の挿入sitting句がconsultantsの同時状態を説明します。

questions.prompt: -------, the outdoor reception will begin at six.

choices.A: Permitting weather is
choices.B: Weather permitted it
choices.D: Weather permitting

questions.translationJa: 天候が許せば、屋外レセプションは6時に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: weatherはpermittingの独立した主語で、主節主語receptionとは別です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing one person doing both actions.

choices.A: The manager left the office, her laptop carrying.
choices.B: The manager left the office carrying her laptop.
choices.C: Carrying her laptop, the office was left by the manager it.
choices.D: The manager carrying left her laptop the office.

questions.translationJa: 部長はノートパソコンを持って事務所を出ました。
questions.explanationJa: leftとcarryingの動作主はmanagerで一致しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with an -ing phrase beside its noun.

choices.A: Mr. Khan, spoken calmly, explained the delay.
choices.B: Speaking calmly, the delay was explained by Mr. Khan it.
choices.C: Mr. Khan speaking, calmly the delay explained.
choices.D: Mr. Khan, speaking calmly, explained the delay.

questions.translationJa: カーンさんは落ち着いて話しながら遅延を説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: speaking calmlyをMr. Khanの直後に挿入し、その人の動作として示します。
questions.focus: 名詞直後の挿入分詞句

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that clearly gives the -ing action a different subject.

choices.A: The meeting ended, the participants leaving in small groups.
choices.B: The meeting ended, leaving in small groups.
choices.C: The meeting ended, the participants left in small groups were.
choices.D: The meeting leaving, participants ended in small groups.

questions.translationJa: 会議が終わり、参加者は小グループごとに退出しました。
questions.explanationJa: endの主語meetingとleaveの主語participantsが異なるため後者を明示します。
questions.focus: 独立分詞構文の別主語

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing an earlier completed action.

choices.A: Reviewing the application after, Ms. Cole scheduled an interview.
choices.B: Having review the application, Ms. Cole scheduled an interview.
choices.C: Having reviewed the application, Ms. Cole scheduled an interview.
choices.D: The application having reviewed, Ms. Cole scheduled an interview.

questions.translationJa: 応募書類を確認し終えてから、コールさんは面接を設定しました。
questions.explanationJa: review完了がscheduleより先なのでHaving reviewedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a passive earlier event.

choices.A: Having repaired, the elevator passed the inspection.
choices.B: Having been repair, the elevator passed the inspection.
choices.C: Been having repaired, the elevator passed the inspection.
choices.D: Having been repaired, the elevator passed the inspection.

questions.translationJa: 修理された後、エレベーターは検査に合格しました。
questions.explanationJa: elevatorは修理される側なのでHaving been repairedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with weather as an independent subject.

choices.A: Permitting weather, the team will inspect the roof tomorrow.
choices.B: Weather permitting, the team will inspect the roof tomorrow.
choices.C: Weather permitted, the roof will inspect the team tomorrow.
choices.D: Weather permitting it, the team will inspect tomorrow the roof.

questions.translationJa: 天候が許せば、チームは明日屋根を検査します。
questions.explanationJa: weatherがpermittingの主語で、主節主語teamとは独立しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct negative perfect participle sentence.

choices.A: Having not receive payment, the supplier held the order.
choices.B: Not received having payment, the supplier held the order.
choices.C: Not having received payment, the supplier held the order.
choices.D: Not having payment received it, the order held the supplier.

questions.translationJa: 支払いを受け取っていなかったため、仕入先は注文を保留しました。
questions.explanationJa: notはHavingの前に置き、receiveの過去分詞receivedを用います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a clearly stated subject for each action.

choices.A: The lights went out, customers using their phones to see.
choices.B: The lights went out, using their phones to see.
choices.C: The lights using their phones, customers went out.
choices.D: Customers went the lights out, using to see phones.

questions.translationJa: 照明が消え、顧客は見るために携帯電話を使いました。
questions.explanationJa: go outの主語lightsとuseの主語customersが異なるため両方を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence placing an -ing scene at the beginning.

choices.A: Crossing the warehouse floor, a forklift alarm heard me.
choices.B: Crossed the warehouse floor, I hearing a forklift alarm.
choices.C: Crossing, the warehouse floor I heard was an alarm.
choices.D: Crossing the warehouse floor, I heard a forklift alarm.

questions.translationJa: 倉庫のフロアを横切っていると、フォークリフトの警報が聞こえました。
questions.explanationJa: Crossingの動作主は主節主語Iで、場面を先に示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence combining completion and later departure.

choices.A: Completing the inventory count later, the staff had left for the day.
choices.B: Having complete the inventory count, the staff left for the day.
choices.C: Having completed the inventory count, the staff left for the day.
choices.D: The inventory having completed the staff, left for the day.

questions.translationJa: 在庫数の確認を終えてから、職員はその日の仕事を終えて帰りました。
questions.explanationJa: count完了→退出の順をHaving completedで明示します。
questions.focus: 先行完了と主節の時間順

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Having finished the audit, the team issued its findings."

choices.A: The team issued findings before starting the audit.
choices.B: The audit finished the team’s findings.
choices.C: The team never completed or reported the audit.
choices.D: After the team finished the audit, it issued its findings.

questions.translationJa: 監査を終えた後、チームは調査結果を発表しました。
questions.explanationJa: Having finishedは主節より前に完了した行為をafter節で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The door opened, several guests entering at once."

choices.A: Several guests opened after the door entered.
choices.B: The door opened, and several guests entered at once.
choices.D: No guests came in when the door opened.

questions.translationJa: ドアが開き、複数の来客が一斉に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: doorとguestsで動作主が異なり、独立主語several guestsが明示されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Ms. Lane, holding the receipt, spoke to the clerk."

choices.A: The clerk held Ms. Lane while speaking to a receipt.
choices.B: Ms. Lane gave away the receipt before speaking.
choices.C: Ms. Lane held the receipt while she spoke to the clerk.
choices.D: The receipt spoke to the clerk.

questions.translationJa: レーンさんは領収書を持ちながら係員に話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞そばのholding句はMs. Laneの同時動作です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Having been notified, all employees left the building."

choices.A: After all employees had been notified, they left the building.
choices.B: Employees notified the building after leaving.
choices.C: No employee received notice before leaving.
choices.D: The building left after notifying employees.

questions.translationJa: 通知を受けた後、全従業員が建物を退出しました。
questions.explanationJa: Having been notifiedは受動の先行完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The presentation over, attendees moved to the lobby."

choices.A: The presentation moved attendees out of the lobby.
choices.B: After the presentation was over, attendees moved to the lobby.
choices.C: Attendees ended the lobby presentation later.
choices.D: The lobby was over the attendees.

questions.translationJa: 発表が終わると、参加者はロビーへ移動しました。
questions.explanationJa: presentationを独立主語とする状態句が主節の時間背景です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Not having seen the update, I used the old form."

choices.A: I saw the update and avoided the old form.
choices.B: The old form updated itself before I used it.
choices.C: I used no form because the update was old.
choices.D: Because I had not seen the update, I used the old form.

questions.translationJa: 更新を見ていなかったため、古い用紙を使いました。
questions.explanationJa: Not having seenは主節以前の未経験を理由として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The truck departed, its doors securely locked."

choices.A: The truck departed while its doors were securely locked.
choices.B: The doors departed after locking the truck.
choices.C: The truck left every door open.
choices.D: The driver locked the doors after the truck arrived.

questions.translationJa: トラックはドアをしっかり施錠した状態で出発しました。
questions.explanationJa: its doorsが独立した主語で、lockedという付帯状態を示します。
questions.focus: 独立主語＋過去分詞状態

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Having compared all bids, we selected Arlo Services."

choices.A: We selected a bid before making any comparison.
choices.B: Arlo Services compared us with every bidder.
choices.C: We selected Arlo Services after comparing all bids.
choices.D: All bids were selected without review.

questions.translationJa: すべての入札を比較した後、アルロ・サービスを選びました。
questions.explanationJa: Having comparedは選定より前の完了行為です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The guests, waiting patiently, remained near reception."

choices.A: The guests remained near reception while they waited patiently.
choices.B: Reception waited for the guests elsewhere.
choices.C: The guests left because they were impatient.
choices.D: Patience moved reception near the guests.

questions.translationJa: 来客は辛抱強く待ちながら受付近くにいました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞直後のwaiting句はguestsの同時動作を挿入しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Business permitting, Mr. Fox will extend his trip."

choices.A: Mr. Fox will extend every business trip unconditionally.
choices.B: If his business obligations permit, Mr. Fox will extend his trip.
choices.C: The trip will permit Mr. Fox’s business.
choices.D: Business ended because Mr. Fox traveled.

questions.translationJa: 仕事の都合がつけば、フォックスさんは旅行を延長します。
questions.explanationJa: businessを独立主語とするpermitting句はif条件に近い意味です。
questions.focus: 独立分詞構文の条件意味

questions.prompt: The analyst completed a final data check at noon. ------- every figure, she sent the forecast.

choices.A: Verifying after
choices.B: Having verify
choices.D: Verified having

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者は正午に最終データ確認を終えました。全数値を検証してから予測を送りました。
questions.explanationJa: 検証完了が送信より先なのでHaving verifiedを使います。

questions.prompt: The bell rang at the end of the seminar, ------- toward the exits.

choices.A: participants moving
choices.B: moving
choices.D: to move participants

questions.translationJa: セミナー終了時にベルが鳴り、参加者は出口へ移動しました。
questions.explanationJa: ringの主語bellとmoveの主語participantsが異なるため明示します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Green approached the counter. Mr. Green, ------- a claim form, asked for assistance.

choices.A: held
choices.B: to hold
choices.D: holding

questions.translationJa: グリーンさんは窓口へ近づきました。請求用紙を持ちながら支援を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: holding句はMr. Greenの直後でその人の同時動作を説明します。

questions.prompt: The equipment passed a second test. -------, it was returned to production.

choices.A: Having recalibrated
choices.B: Having been recalibrated
choices.D: Recalibrated having

questions.translationJa: 機器は2回目の試験に合格しました。再校正された後、生産現場へ戻されました。
questions.explanationJa: equipmentは再校正される側で、その完了が返却より前です。

questions.prompt: The power failed during the call, ------- from the video meeting.

choices.A: disconnecting
choices.B: several employees disconnected were
choices.D: to disconnect several employees

questions.translationJa: 通話中に停電し、複数の従業員がビデオ会議から切断されました。
questions.explanationJa: failの主語powerとdisconnectの主語employeesが異なるため独立主語が必要です。

questions.prompt: We still lacked the client’s signature Friday morning. ------- it, we delayed the shipment.

choices.A: Not having received
choices.B: Having not receive
choices.D: Not receiving after

questions.translationJa: 金曜朝の時点でも顧客の署名がありませんでした。それを受け取っていなかったため配送を延期しました。
questions.explanationJa: 未受領が延期より前の理由なのでNot having receivedです。

questions.prompt: The loading dock was quiet, ------- outside with their engines off.

choices.A: waiting
choices.B: three trucks waiting
choices.D: to wait three trucks

questions.translationJa: 搬入口は静かで、トラック3台がエンジンを切って外で待っていました。
questions.explanationJa: waitingの独立主語three trucksを示し、dockとは別の場面を足します。

questions.prompt: All approval emails arrived by noon. ------- them, the coordinator released the order.

choices.A: Reviewing after
choices.B: Having review
choices.D: Having reviewed

questions.translationJa: 正午までに承認メールがすべて届きました。確認し終えてから、担当者は注文を確定しました。
questions.explanationJa: reviewの完了後にreleaseした時間順をHaving reviewedで表します。

questions.prompt: The outdoor product demonstration is planned for Saturday. -------, it will begin at ten.

choices.A: Weather permitting
choices.B: Permitting weather it
choices.D: Having permit weather

questions.translationJa: 屋外製品実演は土曜日の予定です。天候が許せば10時に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: weatherがpermittingの主語となる独立条件表現です。

questions.prompt: The director entered the hall. The director, ------- to both sides, greeted the assembled staff.

choices.A: waved
choices.B: waving
choices.D: having wave

questions.translationJa: 部長がホールに入りました。両側に手を振りながら、集まった職員に挨拶しました。
questions.explanationJa: waving句をdirectorのそばに置き、その人の同時動作を明確にします。
questions.focus: 配置による名詞への直接説明
